title: Changia ZEC na udai punguzo la kodi nchini Marekani
description: Ukurasa huu unatoa maelezo ya jumla, si ushauri wa kisheria au wa kodi. Sheria za kodi nchini Marekani hubadilika, kwa hiyo angalia hali yako pamoja na mshauri…
text: Changia ZEC na udai punguzo la kodi nchini Marekani Kiwango cha kati - dakika 10 Ukurasa huu unatoa maelezo ya jumla, si ushauri wa kisheria au wa kodi. Sheria za kodi nchini Marekani hubadilika, kwa hiyo angalia hali yako pamoja na mshauri wa kodi. Kila sheria hapa chini ina kiungo cha chanzo chake cha IRS, kilichokaguliwa Oktoba 2026 dhidi ya Publication 526 (kwa marejesho ya kodi ya 2025) na ukurasa wa IRS kuhusu sheria ya kodi ya 2025. Kwa ufupi IRS huchukulia ZEC kama mali, hivyo zawadi ya ZEC ni mchango usio wa fedha taslimu Ikiwa ulishikilia ZEC kwa zaidi ya mwaka mmoja, kwa kawaida unaweza kukata thamani yake halisi ya soko na usilipe kodi ya faida ya mtaji kwa ongezeko hilo Ikiwa ulishikilia kwa mwaka mmoja au chini ya hapo, punguzo lako ni kiasi kidogo kati ya ulicholipa na thamani yake ya soko Kwa zawadi ya $250 au zaidi, unahitaji uthibitisho wa maandishi kutoka kwa shirika la hisani Zaidi ya $500, unatuma Form 8283. Zaidi ya $5,000, pia unahitaji tathmini inayostahiki Unapata punguzo hilo tu ikiwa unaorodhesha makato yako. Punguzo jipya kwa watu wasioorodhesha makato, linaloanza mwaka 2026, linahusu zawadi za fedha taslimu pekee, si ZEC Hii ni kwa ajili ya nani? Walipa kodi wa Marekani wanaotaka kutoa ZEC kwa shirika la hisani Wafadhili wanaotaka zawadi yao ibaki ya faragha on-chain na bado wadai punguzo Ikiwa unasimamia shirika la hisani, angalia Kupokea Michango ya Faragha kama Shirika Lisilo la Faida la Marekani. Ya faragha on-chain, yanayojulikana kwa shirika la hisani Zawadi ya faragha huhifadhi kiasi, anwani yako na salio la shirika la hisani nje ya rekodi ya umma. Punguzo la kodi ni aina tofauti ya faragha: kwa zawadi yoyote ya $250 au zaidi, shirika la hisani lazima lijue wewe ni nani ili likutumie uthibitisho, na zaidi ya $5,000 mtathmini wako na shirika la hisani wote husaini Form 8283 yako. Kwa hiyo unaweza kuwa wa faragha kwa umma na bado udai punguzo. Huwezi kubaki bila kujulikana kwa shirika la hisani na kulidai kwa zawadi ya $250 au zaidi. Unachohitaji Pochi ya faragha inayoshikilia ZEC utakayotoa Rekodi ya lini ulipata ZEC hiyo na kiasi ulicholipia Shirika la hisani ambalo ni shirika linalostahiki (likague kwenye IRS Utafutaji wa Mashirika Yaliyosamehewa Kodi) na linakubali ZEC. Angalia Mahali pa Kutoa Mchango ZEC Mwongozo wa hatua kwa hatua Hatua ya 1: Angalia muda ambao umeshikilia ZEC Zaidi ya mwaka mmoja: ZEC ni mali ya mtaji, kwa hivyo ni mali yenye faida ya mtaji. Kwa kawaida unaweza kukata thamani yake halisi ya soko siku unayoitoa (Publication 526, IRS Maswali Yanayoulizwa Mara kwa Mara, S34–S35) Mwaka mmoja au chini ya hapo: punguzo lako ni kiasi kidogo kati ya msingi wako wa gharama (kwa kawaida ulicholipa) na thamani yake halisi ya soko siku hiyo (IRS Maswali Yanayoulizwa Mara kwa Mara, S35) Ikiwa ulinunua ZEC kwa nyakati tofauti, toa kutoka katika fungu ambalo umelishikilia zaidi ya mwaka mmoja na uhifadhi dokezo la ulilotumia. Hatua ya 2: Angalia shirika la hisani Hakikisha shirika linaweza kupokea zawadi zinazokatwa kodi, na usome linachosema kuhusu risiti za sarafu za kidijitali [crypto]. Baadhi ya mashirika ya hisani hayatumi uthibitisho wa sarafu za kidijitali kabisa. Mahali pa Kutoa Mchango ZEC huorodhesha kile ambacho kila shirika linasema. Hatua ya 3: Tuma zawadi na uliambie shirika la hisani wewe ni nani Nakili anwani kutoka kwenye ukurasa wa shirika la hisani wenyewe wa kutoa mchango Tuma kutoka kwenye pochi yako ya faragha Ikiwa shirika la hisani lina anwani ya faragha, weka jina lako na barua pepe katika ujumbe, au tumia njia ya mawasiliano kwenye ukurasa wake wa kutoa mchango Hatua ya 4: Andika thamani ya siku hiyo Rekodi tarehe na saa, kiasi cha ZEC, thamani yake kwa dola za Marekani wakati huo na mahali ulipopata bei hiyo. Hifadhi kitambulisho cha muamala. Angalia Kuhifadhi rekodi kwa ZEC za faragha. Hatua ya 5: Pata uthibitisho wa maandishi Kwa zawadi yoyote moja ya $250 au zaidi, unahitaji uthibitisho wa maandishi wa wakati unaofaa kutoka kwa shirika la hisani. Unaeleza

title: Endesha kampeni ya kuchangisha fedha ya ZEC
description: Ikiwa wewe ni shirika lisilo la faida la Marekani, soma Kubali Michango ya Faragha kama Shirika Lisilo la Faida la Marekani kwanza kwa ajili ya risiti na fomu…
text: Endesha kampeni ya kuchangisha fedha ya ZEC Kiwango cha kati - dakika 10 Kwa ufupi Ipe kampeni akaunti yake ya pochi na anwani ya faragha [shielded address], ili isichanganyike kamwe na fedha nyingine Shiriki kiungo cha ombi la malipo au msimbo wa QR wenye kiasi kilichopendekezwa na ujumbe [memo] uliokwisha kujazwa Onyesha maendeleo bila kufichua wafadhili: chapisha jumla mwenyewe, au mpe mkaguzi mmoja anayeaminika ufunguo wa kutazama [viewing key] Ufunguo wa kutazama unahusu akaunti nzima, si anwani moja tu, ndiyo sababu kampeni hupata akaunti yake yenyewe Funga kampeni katika tarehe uliyoahidi na uchapishe jinsi fedha zilivyotumika Hii ni kwa ajili ya nani? Vikundi vya jamii, miradi ya chanzo huria na wabunifu wanaochangisha fedha kwa lengo moja Mashirika yasiyo ya faida yanayoendesha ombi la mwisho wa mwaka au la dharura katika ZEC Mtu yeyote anayetaka wafadhili waamini kampeni bila kufanya kila zawadi iwe ya umma Ikiwa wewe ni shirika lisilo la faida la Marekani, soma Kubali Michango ya Faragha kama Shirika Lisilo la Faida la Marekani kwanza kwa ajili ya risiti na fomu za IRS. Tatizo Michango mingi ya crypto hutumia anwani ya uwazi [transparent address] ili wafadhili waweze kuona jumla ikiongezeka. Hilo pia huonyesha kila zawadi, kiasi chake, ilipowasili na fedha zinaenda wapi baadaye. Wafadhili wanaotoa kwa faragha kimakusudi hupoteza faragha hiyo [privacy], na mtu yeyote anaweza kufuatilia fedha baada ya kampeni. Kampeni yenye faragha kamili ina tatizo kinyume: wafadhili hawawezi kuona kama lengo lilifikiwa au jinsi fedha zilivyotumika. Kwa nini Zcash? Kwa ZEC ya faragha, kila zawadi husalia ya faragha on-chain, na unaamua cha kuonyesha: jumla, upau wa maendeleo, au ufikiaji wa kusoma pekee kwa mkaguzi. Wafadhili wanaweza kuongeza ujumbe katika memo, na unaweza kuwashukuru bila mtu mwingine kuona aliyetoa. Unachohitaji pochi ya faragha ambapo unaweza kuunda akaunti tofauti Ukurasa wa kampeni: tovuti, chapisho la mitandao ya kijamii au mjadala wa jukwaa Lengo, tarehe ya mwisho na mpango wa jinsi fedha zitakavyotumika Mwongozo wa hatua kwa hatua Hatua ya 1: Weka lengo na kanuni Andika yafuatayo kabla ya kuzindua: Kiasi unachokusanya na kitakacholipiwa nacho Tarehe ya mwisho Kinachotokea ikiwa utakusanya zaidi au chini ya lengo Anayedhibiti fedha, na kama zaidi ya mtu mmoja lazima aidhinishe matumizi (tazama Endesha Hazina ya Faragha ya Jamii) Chapisha haya kwenye ukurasa wa kampeni. Wafadhili huamini kampeni inayosema mapema itakachofanya. Hatua ya 2: Unda akaunti tofauti kwa ajili ya kampeni Unda akaunti mpya katika pochi yako, itakayotumiwa kwa kampeni hii pekee, kisha nakili anwani ya faragha kutoka humo. Kuweka kampeni tofauti hufanya jumla iwe rahisi kusoma, na ni muhimu baadaye ikiwa utashiriki ufunguo wa kutazama, kwa sababu ufunguo wa kutazama huonyesha shughuli za akaunti nzima (Funguo za Kutazama). Hatua ya 3: Tengeneza kiungo cha ombi la malipo na msimbo wa QR URI ya ombi la malipo ni kiungo cha zcash: kinachojaza anwani, kiasi kilichopendekezwa na ujumbe kwa mfadhili. Tumia ZecHub ya kizalishaji cha ombi la malipo kutengeneza kimoja, kisha kishiriki kama kiungo na msimbo wa QR. Ujumbe kama “Jina la kampeni, jibu kwa: barua pepe yako au jina lako la mtandaoni” huwasaidia wafadhili wanaotaka shukrani au risiti. Sema kwenye ukurasa kwamba ujumbe ni wa hiari. Hatua ya 4: Zindua ukurasa wa kampeni Weka kwenye ukurasa: Lengo, tarehe ya mwisho na kanuni kutoka Hatua ya 1 Anwani ya faragha, msimbo wa QR na kiungo Jinsi ya kutoa kutoka pochi ya faragha, na mahali pa kupata moja Jinsi utakavyoripoti maendeleo (Hatua ya 5) Bandika anwani mahali pamoja na uwaambie wafadhili kuinakili kutoka hapo pekee. Hatua ya 5: Ripoti maendeleo bila kufichua wafadhili Chagua moja na useme ni ipi kwenye ukurasa: Chapisha jumla mwenyewe, kwa mfano mara moja kwa wiki, kutoka salio la pochi yako la akaunti ya kampeni Mpe mkaguzi mmoja anayeaminika ufunguo wa kutazama, kama vile mwanachama wa bodi au mwanajamii anayejulikana na wafadhili, am

title: How to run Zakura on Akash Network
description: Step-by-step path for a Zakura Zcash full node using the awesome-akash zcash-zakura template.
text: How to run Zakura on Akash Network Step-by-step path for a Zakura Zcash full node using the awesome-akash zcash-zakura template. Zakura is a consensus-compatible Zcash node (forked from Zebra) with faster sync, native pruning, and snapshot bootstrap. This template pins zakuracore/zakura:1.8.1 (digest-pinned; do not use :latest or 1.1.1). What you get Mainnet P2P: container 8233, published globally (see port mapping below) Persistent pruned state (64 GiB default) with Valar snapshot bootstrap on first start Prometheus 9999 and health 8080 (internal, no public URI) JSON-RPC 8232 internal for colocated lightwalletd; LWD listens on container 9067 and is published globally Feature flags in the SDL (true/false): ENABLEMETRICS, ENABLEHEALTH, ENABLERPC, ENABLELIGHTWALLETD. Cookie auth is off when lightwalletd is on, because lightwalletd cannot read cookie files. Which site to use (payments) The SDL is the same. The two Akash web UIs differ in how you pay. Site Payments Wallet --- --- --- console.akash.network Traditional web checkout (card / fiat rails Console offers) Console account air.akash.network Native Akash chain payments (AKT / ACT) Keplr Use Air when you want to pay with Keplr on-chain. Use Console when you want a conventional web payment flow. Do not expect Keplr native settlement on Console. Deploy Web payments (Console) Native Akash payments with Keplr (Air) Open this template on Air Open the matching link above (Console or Air). On Air, connect Keplr and confirm you have AKT/ACT for deposit and lease. On Console, complete the web checkout the UI presents. Load zcash-zakura/deploy.yaml if it is not already filled in. Deposit, accept a bid, wait for the lease. Logs should show snapshot download (first start) then zakurad start. Open Leases → URIs. Use the host:port the provider assigned, not 8233 or 9067 on the public IP. How Akash publishes ports SDL port / as (8233, 9067, 8232) are container ports. Zakura still listens on 8233; lightwalletd on 9067; RPC on 8232 for the LWD sidecar (zakura:8232). They are not the ports on the provider's public IP. Default (this template): no dedicated IP. Each global: true TCP expose is mapped to a random high port on a shared provider host. Console/Air list them as lease URIs, for example: Peers dial the 8233 URI (provider.example:31482). Compact wallets use the 9067 URI (TLS off unless you terminate TLS yourself). Set ZAKURANETWORKEXTERNALADDR to the mapped P2P URI, not :8233. Internal exposes (8232 RPC, 9999 metrics, 8080 health) stay on the deployment network. No public URI. Dedicated IPs (endpoints / kind: ip) are a paid extra and are not in this template. They can pin a public IP and sometimes the as port. Add that only if you need a stable host:8233. Archive vs pruned Default is pruned (11 GiB snapshot, 64 GiB disk). For full history set SNAPSHOTKIND=archive, raise disk to 350 GiB+, and set ZAKURASTATESTORAGEMODE=archive. Related Zebra on Akash — Zcash Foundation zebrad (full history, no snapshot) Thus Spoke Zakura on Akash — Regtest dashboard + app (v0.4.1) Zakura source: github.com/zakura-core/zakura Snapshots: zakura.com/snapshots/

title: Thus Spoke Zakura on Akash (Regtest)
description: Run the Thus Spoke Zakura v0.4.1 stack on Akash: Zakura Regtest, lightwalletd, and the wallet dashboard / HTTP API. Test coins have no value. Do not send…
text: Thus Spoke Zakura on Akash (Regtest) Run the Thus Spoke Zakura v0.4.1 stack on Akash: Zakura Regtest, lightwalletd, and the wallet dashboard / HTTP API. Test coins have no value. Do not send mainnet ZEC here. Template: awesome-akash/thus-spoke-zakura Upstream: zcashlabs/thus-spoke-zakura tag v0.4.1 Images Service Image --- --- Dashboard + API (app) ghcr.io/zcashlabs/thus-spoke-zakura-app:0.4.1 lightwalletd ghcr.io/zcashlabs/thus-spoke-zakura-lightwalletd:0.4.1 Zakura zakuracore/zakura:1.6.0 (pin compiled into the 0.4.1 launcher) Self-bootstrap On first start the app container runs ths-server init on its persistent volume, then ths-server serve. Serve retries until Zakura JSON-RPC and lightwalletd are up. You do not run ths on the provider; the SDL is the runtime. How Akash publishes ports SDL port / as are container ports. The app listens on 8080 (THSLISTEN); lightwalletd on 9067; Zakura RPC on 18232 and P2P on 18233. Inside the deployment, services already use those (http://zakura:18232, http://lightwalletd:9067). They are not the ports on the provider's public IP. Default (this template): no dedicated IP. Service Container listen SDL as How it shows up on the lease --- --- --- --- app (dashboard + HTTP API) 8080 80 (HTTP) Ingress hostname, often on 80/443 — open this URI in a browser lightwalletd 9067 9067 (TCP, global) host: random-high-port zakura RPC 18232 18232 (TCP, global) host: random-high-port zakura P2P 18233 18233 (TCP, global) host: random-high-port After the lease is ready, Leases → URIs is the source of truth. Open the app URI for the dashboard (the same UI ths opens locally). Point compact clients at the lightwalletd URI (THSLIGHTWALLETDTLS=false). Do not type :8080, :80, or :9067 on the provider IP unless a dedicated IP lease made those ports public. Dedicated IPs (endpoints / kind: ip) are a paid extra and are not in this template. They can pin a public IP and sometimes the as port. Leave them off unless you need that. Which site to use (payments) The SDL is the same. The two Akash web UIs differ in how you pay. Site Payments Wallet --- --- --- console.akash.network Traditional web checkout (card / fiat rails Console offers) Console account air.akash.network Native Akash chain payments (AKT / ACT) Keplr Use Air when you want to pay with Keplr on-chain. Use Console when you want a conventional web payment flow. Deploy Web payments (Console) Native Akash payments with Keplr (Air) Open this template on Air Create the deployment from the template, accept a bid, wait until app logs show ths-server serve staying up, then open the app URI for the dashboard. title: Mwongozo wa msanidi programu [developer] wa Zcash JS
description: zcash.js (@zcashlabs/zcash.js) ni SDK ya majaribio ya TypeScript/JavaScript iliyotolewa na Zcash Labs tarehe 26 Oktoba 2026. Inawawezesha wasanidi programu…
text: Mwongozo wa msanidi programu [developer] wa Zcash JS zcash.js (@zcashlabs/zcash.js) ni SDK ya majaribio ya TypeScript/JavaScript iliyotolewa na Zcash Labs tarehe 26 Oktoba 2026. Inawawezesha wasanidi programu kutengeneza pochi [wallet], light client, dashibodi [dashboard], na programu zinazoingiliana na mtandao wa Zcash kutoka Node.js na kivinjari. Hali: Ya majaribio (v0.1.1). Pochi za Node zinazodumu kwa sasa zinahitaji Linux + flock. Kutuma/kupokea kikamilifu katika kivinjari cha moja kwa moja na uhamishaji wa kihistoria wa hifadhidata ya pochi bado havijaidhinishwa kikamilifu. Daima angalia nyaraka rasmi kabla ya matumizi ya uzalishaji. SDK Hutoa Nini createPublicClient — hoja za JSON-RPC zisizo na hali na uchunguzi wa miamala [transactions] createLightClient — hoja na mitiririko ya lightwallet (gRPC asilia kwenye Node, gRPC-Web katika kivinjari) createWalletClient — akaunti za ndani, uchanganuzi, mapendekezo, utiaji sahihi, uwasilishaji, na urejeshaji wa malipo [payments] yaliyorekodiwa Kiasi sahihi cha bigint, uthibitishaji wa mtandao, vifaa [tools] vya kutazama/anwani [address], na vifaa vya PCZT Injini ya msingi ya pochi iliyojumuishwa, workers, na rasilimali za uthibitishaji za ndani za Sapling (hakuna usakinishaji tofauti wa Rust unaohitajika) Usakinishaji Tumia Node.js 22.23.4 (toleo lililobandikwa na kifurushi). Pendelea TypeScript yenye ESM ("type": "module" katika package.json). Programu za kivinjari hufanya kazi kupitia bundler ya kisasa ya ESM. Bundler itatoa rasilimali za WASM, worker, na uthibitishaji zinazopakiwa kwa uvivu — hizi lazima zitumwe pamoja na programu yako. Hoja ya Kwanza ya Mnyororo [Chain] (Bila Pochi) Kuacha chaguo la network hutumia mainnet kwa chaguomsingi (toa endpoint inayolingana). createPublicClient pia inapatikana kwa matumizi safi ya JSON-RPC. Kufungua Pochi Chaguo za Hifadhi Mazingira Chaguo la hifadhi ----------------- ----------------------------------------------------- Node (ya kudumu) { kind: 'node-filesystem', path: './my-wallet' } Kivinjari { kind: 'browser-opfs', name: 'my-wallet' } Ya muda { kind: 'memory' } Chaguomsingi muhimu (kuanzia v0.1.1): Matumizi na chenji ni Ironwood-pekee kwa chaguomsingi Kanuni ya ada [fee]: ZIP-317 Uthibitisho: 3 wa kuaminika / 3 wasioaminika Daima ita wallet.sync() kabla ya kupendekeza malipo Mtiririko wa Kazi wa Pochi wa Kiwango cha Juu Unda au leta akaunti ya mnemonic na uambatishe mtia sahihi Ita wallet.sync() Omba anwani ya kupokea (pendekeza Unified / Ironwood) Unda pendekezo → likague → ita wallet.send() Fuatilia uthibitisho au tumia operesheni zilizorekodiwa kwa urejeshaji baada ya kuwasha upya Programu inamiliki baiti za mnemonic. Zifute kutoka kwenye kumbukumbu zisipohitajika tena. Daima wasilisha kiolesura wazi cha uidhinishaji kinachoonyesha kila mpokeaji, kiasi, ada, bwawa [pool], na muda wa mwisho. Tazama mwongozo rasmi wa Pochi kwa mfano kamili unaofanya kazi. Maelezo ya Mfumo na Vikwazo vya Sasa Uwezo Node Kivinjari ----------------------- ----------------------------------- ---------------------------------- Kifurushi Node 22.23.4 + ESM Bundler ya kisasa ya ESM + WebAssembly Hoja nyepesi gRPC asilia gRPC-Web + CORS Hifadhi ya kudumu Linux + flock pekee OPFS (muktadha salama) Hifadhi ya muda kumbukumbu kumbukumbu Vikwazo vya ziada: Hifadhi endelevu ya Node kwa sasa ni ya Linux-pekee Bado hakuna vault ya siri inayosimamiwa, huduma ya uthibitishaji ya mbali, au ujumuishaji wa mtia sahihi wa hardware Hifadhi haitangazwi kuwa imesimbwa fiche [encrypted] inapohifadhiwa Usifungue hifadhi ileile ya pochi kutoka kwa michakato mingi au vichupo vya kivinjari kwa wakati mmoja Daima funga pochi kwa usahihi ukitumia await wallet.close() Hatua Zinazofuata Usakinishaji rasmi na ombi la kwanza: Usakinishaji Kufungua na kusanidi pochi: Fungua pochi Mtiririko kamili wa kazi: Mwongozo wa pochi Marejeleo ya API: Marejeleo ya API Vikomo vya mfumo: Usanidi wa Node na kivinjari Rasilimali Rasmi Kitabu cha wasanidi programu: https://zcashlabs.github.io/zca
